stage.name: Entry Permit
stage.description:
Condition:
More <Turrets> appear, and <Turrets> deal more damage.

elite_famiglia_soldier.name: Elite Famiglia Soldier
elite_famiglia_soldier.flavourText: Battle-hardened, low-level mafiosi who are strong and swift-footed, worthy of being called elite fighters. When they are buried, the famiglia might send a letter of condolence home, nothing more.
abilities: Increases Blood Debt by a miniscule amount when defeated

famiglia_terrorizer.name: Famiglia Terrorizer
famiglia_terrorizer.flavourText: An exceptionally herculean famiglia strongman, known for his fiery temper. He does not begrudge the visits he pays to the relatives of others, but during key moments, his word is more resolute than stone.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by allied units

elite_famiglia_crossbowman.name: Elite Famiglia Crossbowman
elite_famiglia_crossbowman.flavourText: Famiglia-trained crossbowmen with a wealth of experience. Their shots are more accurate, and more deadly as well. Famiglie always respect the ironclad order, so these crossbows are never upgraded into better models, and Arts remain just as essential as ever.
abilities: While under the Asset Liquidation status, attacks are converted into Arts damage

miner_guerrilla.name: Miner Guerrilla
miner_guerrilla.flavourText: Resistance unit formed by miners, many of whom are still relatively young. They are not a rampaging mob: all they want to do is protect their families who are still underground.
abilities: Allied unit; recovers HP when within any Medic Operator's Attack Range

famiglia_luxury_limo.name: Famiglia Luxury Limo
famiglia_luxury_limo.flavourText: A lesser-seen vehicle among the famiglie, sporting an unassuming exterior but a luxurious interior. Generally, these are only used to welcome the most distinguished of the famiglia's guests, and to convey to them the graces of the famiglia's high-ranking members.
abilities: Unloads 3 <Elite Famiglia Soldiers> if this is unit is defeated while blocked

famiglia_heavy_capo.name: Famiglia Heavy Capo
famiglia_heavy_capo.flavourText: A ruthless famiglia capo who has commanded the awe of a great many mafiosi. He was there when the famiglie first rose to greatness, and withstood the tumultuous years of change up until the present. It seems that nothing can topple him now.
abilities: Increases Blood Debt whenever an enemy unit is defeated within range

father_agenir.name: Father Agenir
father_agenir.flavourText: Agenir, Sankta priest, one of the founders of Siracusa's ironclad order. Do not hesitate–though he does not necessarily stand opposed to you, his guns speak first. By the way, his favorite eye mask was made in Lungmen.
abilities: Attacks have global range when Asset Liquidation is active
Attacks using Ammo decrease the target's DEF. Ammo capacity: 10
